# Architecture (post-cutover)

Snapshot of the **segv** cluster as observed on 2026-10-21, two days after the cutover from the Calico/Istio/OpenEBS cluster described in `docs/segv-snapshot-2026-10-17.md`. That earlier file is kept as a record of the old cluster and is not updated.

Method: read-only `kubectl` (`infra/clusters/segv/kube.conf`) and read-only SSH to `core@tachyon.lan`. The one change made during the observation was a planned reboot of the node (see "Reboot test"). The cluster is in its soak period (see `docs/segv-soak-plan.md`).

## Overview

| | |
|---|---|
| Cluster | `segv`, a single bare-metal node: `tachyon.lan` (10.0.0.6), labelled controller, schedulable (the `NoSchedule` taint was removed by hand, #61) |
| Kubernetes | v1.36.2, containerd 2.3.5 |
| OS | Fedora CoreOS 44.20260928.3.1, kernel 7.2.7, rebased with `rpm-ostree` onto `ghcr.io/alxbl/lab/fcos` (ZFS layer, build 20261019) |
| Hardware | 8-disk ZFS `raidz2` pool `data` (8.72T, 3.33T allocated, 38% full, 9% fragmented, ONLINE, no errors) mounted at `/var/data` |
| Provisioning | Terraform wrapping upstream `poseidon/typhoon` at a pinned git ref (`os_version` 44.20260913.3.2), matchbox and PXE |
| GitOps | ArgoCD v3.5.2, app-of-apps tracking `HEAD` of `github.com/alxbl/lab`, no automated sync on any app |
| CNI | Cilium 1.18.14 (Helm via `scripts/install-cilium.sh`, adopted by ArgoCD) |
| Service mesh | none (Istio is gone) |
| Storage | static `local-zfs` PVs on ZFS datasets (OpenEBS is gone) |

## Networking

| | |
|---|---|
| Node/LAN | 10.0.0.0/16 (node 10.0.0.6) |
| Pod CIDR | 10.2.0.0/16 |
| Service CIDR | 10.3.0.0/16 (must be routed to the node by the LAN router) |
| Cilium | kube-proxy replacement, host firewall (enabled on `eno1`), WireGuard pod-to-pod encryption (node encryption disabled), Hubble, LB-IPAM with L2 announcements |
| Ingress | Gateway API: `GatewayClass cilium`, `gateway/https-in-gw` at `10.3.0.2` (80/443), TLS cert `https-in-gw-cert` (cert-manager, Ready) |
| SMB | `media/smbd` is a `LoadBalancer` sharing `10.3.0.2` on 445 |
| Routes | HTTPRoutes: `argocd` and `lab-root` (`lab.segfault.me`), `home-assistant` (`home.segfault.me`), `vaultwarden` (`vault.segfault.me`), `jellyfin` (`lab.segfault.me`), `photoprism`, `redirect-https` |
| Policy | `CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy`: `gateway-allow-sources`, `host-allow-cluster`, `host-allow-lan` |

## Storage

- StorageClass `local-zfs` (`kubernetes.io/no-provisioner`, `Retain`, `WaitForFirstConsumer`). PVs are declared in `infra/system/storage` and pre-bound to their claim.
- Seven PVs: `adguard` (5Gi), `home-assistant` (5Gi), `vaultwarden` (5Gi), `media` (2Ti, RWX), `smbd` (1Ti, RWX) are Bound; `photoprism-db` (50Gi) and `satisfactory` (28Gi) are Available because their apps are not provisioned.
- Datasets under `data/k8s` and their usage: `media` 1.72T, `smbd` 262G, `photoprism-db` 23.4G, `satisfactory` 28.9M, `adguard` 52M, `home-assistant` 41M, `vaultwarden` 8M, `_probe` (empty probe), `retired-immich-database` (empty, 10G quota) and `retired-immich-library` (233G quota, no user data). The datasets `retired-immich-*` and `_probe` have no PV.
- Rollback snapshots exist and are held (`keep`): `data@pre-cutover`, `data@quiesced`, and `data/k8s/media@pre-pilot`. They are removed only after the soak.
- The pool has disabled features that `zpool upgrade` would enable. It is deliberately not upgraded, to keep the rollback path.

## GitOps layout

```
infra/system/argocd      installs ArgoCD, the `root` app and `system-catalog` app
infra/k8s/catalog        meta-chart: Applications for workloads   (root app)
infra/system/catalog     meta-chart: Applications for system components   (system-catalog app)
charts/                  own Helm charts
infra/k8s/*, infra/system/*   kustomize apps
```

Applications (all manual sync):

| State | Applications |
|---|---|
| Synced and Healthy | `adguard-home`, `aquisition`, `cert-manager`, `cilium`, `cilium-policies`, `gateway-api`, `home-assistant`, `jellyfin`, `root`, `smbd`, `storage`, `system-catalog`, `vaultwarden` |
| Synced, Degraded | `gateway` (see below) |
| OutOfSync, Healthy | `argocd`, `olm`, `velero` (causes not investigated) |
| OutOfSync, Missing (intentionally not provisioned) | `cnpg`, `keycloak`, `photoprism`, `satisfactory` |

`gateway` is Degraded only because the `photoprism` HTTPRoute is defined in `infra/k8s/gateway/overlays/segv/routes.yaml` while its backend `Service/photoprism` does not exist (`ResolvedRefs=False`, `BackendNotFound`). The Gateway itself is Accepted and Programmed and every other route resolves. It clears when photoprism is provisioned or the route is removed.

## Workloads by namespace

| Namespace | Contents |
|---|---|
| `argocd` | ArgoCD v3.5.2 (7 pods) |
| `cert-manager` | cert-manager v1.14.4 (see #63) |
| `gateway` | Gateway `https-in-gw`, Certificate, `lab-root` and `redirect-https` routes |
| `home` | adguard, home-assistant (StatefulSet), vaultwarden |
| `kube-system` | Cilium agent, envoy and operator, Hubble relay, CoreDNS, static control-plane pods |

| `satisfactory` | namespace only |
| `system` | Velero v1.13.0 and its `node-agent` |

27 pods, all Running or Completed after the reboot.

## Backups

- Velero schedule `backup-pv-daily` (`0 3 * * *`, TTL 30 days), BackupStorageLocation `azure` (`Available`, default). Both, and `backup-policy-zfs`, are applied by hand (#62).
- 33 backups exist. The 2026-10-21 run is `Completed` with PodVolumeBackups for vaultwarden, smbd and home-assistant. The 2026-10-20 run was `PartiallyFailed` (#65); the server OOM was fixed by #66.
- Secrets and PKI are exported to Proton Drive (`_secrets/segv`), including the new Terraform state.

## Reboot test (2026-10-21)

The node was rebooted once and was back in about 6 minutes. The pool auto-imported, `/var/data` was mounted, the controller taint stayed removed, the host firewall and Cilium came back healthy, and all workloads returned to Running without intervention.
